parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client to ensure that different requests have unique values. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return order data that has not taken effect. Valid values:

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Express Connect circuit belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.
